profile.headline: Information Technology and Services Professional
profile.summary:
I have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and programming experience in languages such as PHP, HTML with CSS, C/C++, Python, and Perl. I, also, have database experience in MySQL, Postgres, SQLite, Ingres, and Oracle. I have experience programming in both Unix and Microsoft Windows operating systems.
I am a hard working dedicated individual. I currently am a lead developer at Analytical Mechanics Associates as a contractor supporting the CEOS SEO out of NASA Langley.  I worked as a Programmer/CRM Administrator at Cybernetics from 2014 to 2019.  I worked briefly as a Freelance Web Programmer via Odesk Corporation in 2007. I volunteered as webmaster for First Presbyterian Church for four years, 2002 to 2006. I worked for PRC Inc. as a Programmer Analyst developing and maintaining a database application for the U.S. Coast Guard from 1991 to 1993 and 1994 to 1996. I also worked for Science Applications International Corporation as a Software Engineer developing a battle planning application for the U.S. Air Force which involved database programming, systems programming, and the development of a graphical user interface from 1993 to 1994. I am motivated to grow with my career field and learn new things.

positions.title: Programmer/CRM Administrator
positions.description: Responsible for all maintenance, upgrades, customizations, new development, and assisting/training of all users in the Sales and Telemarketing teams. Assisted in migrating data from MarketForce to SugarCRM. Migrated from SugarCRM to SuiteCRM. SugarCRM and SuiteCRM are are based in PHP/Javascript with a MySQL database on Ubuntu Linux. Also wrote extensively in Python to create reports and import/export data, and to create apps to assist in automating routine processes and to analyze data. Also worked with Postgres, and SQLite databases in addition to MySQL.

positions.title: Freelance Programmer
positions.description: Developed a web calendar to help manage rental dates of vacation homes in Yosemite for Chris Falkenstein.  Also, developed a website dubbed Identicools which statistically compared images of people and determined who you most resemble and other statistics for Brian Duryea.  Featured in the Project Spotlight in the April 2007 Odesk Newsletter after completion of the web calendar project for receiving a 5 out of 5 feedback rating from Mr. Falkenstein.  Listed as a Featured Provider in the Odesk News Forum for receiving a 5 out of 5 feedback rating from Mr. Duryea.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: Developed and maintained the church website.  This was a volunteer position.

company.name: First Presbyterian Church of Gloucester, VA

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Assigned to the U.S. Coast Guard’s Aviation Maintenance Management Information System (AMMIS), functioning as a programmer for the Fiscal Accounting, Flight Operations, and Procurement subsystems.  Integrated the technical and functional aspects of the System/Subsystem Specification development effort.  Analyzed, designed, implemented, maintained, and tested reports, screens, and support software.  Utilized UNIX Shell, C, and Ingres 4GL/RW programming in the development of application software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer responsible for several tasks in support of the Contingency Tactical Air Control System (TACS) Automated Planning System (CTAPS) Integration Contract in Hampton, VA.  Responsibilities include determining software requirements, analysis, design, and development.  Also, provide technical support at technical meetings and design reviews.  Technical experience includes software analysis, design, coding, testing, system integration, and fielding of CTAPS’s Air Support Operations Center (ASOC) Remote Data Requestor (RDR) Prototype, and includes software maintenance and testing of CTAPS’s Korean E-Mail.  Additional experience includes UNIX operation systems, ORACLE relational databases, C and Motif on X Windows Systems.  Hardware experience includes SUN SPARC workstations.
